notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Minor spoilers for people who haven't completed the game: 


Fixed [spoiler]Malnews articles[/spoiler] not being able to be closed if window size overlaps top bar, this also fixes visual text bug
Changed [spoiler]Malnews articles[/spoiler] open behaviour to occur on full click rather than on just clicking down
Fixed the dreaded hit detection bug in [spoiler]9-5 mode[/spoiler] that has plagued my sleep since launch


Thanks for playing, bug reports can be submitted in the Steam community discussion or here: https://discord.gg/enAsFd6ufH
